detail: Stage B was wired after these files were rendered, so they never saw it.
Stage C, the negative controls and the bootstrap had not been executed.
S1/S2/S3/R1/R2/R3/A1/A2 were decided by inline conditions in stages.py rather than by the frozen gates.py reducers.
The real gates were computed from M5 alone, but the frozen FrozenPrimaryDatasetManifest requires at least two audited datasets.
RECOMMEND_CHARACTERIZATION_ONLY came from S1 PASS, but the frozen truth table defines characterization_clear as S3 GO or R2 GO.
